head: 235859c5d61180d91f3db63582f2a06b0ae6249f
title: Add euro formatting and EUR switching to Corner Shop
body:
## Summary

Add cent-based EUR formatting with European separators, so `format(123456, "EUR")` returns `€1.234,56`. Corner Shop now offers EUR alongside USD and JPY in server and static views, using the fixed demo rate of 1 USD = 0.92 EUR.

## Why

Euro amounts need the requested cent-based display, and Corner Shop needs a selectable euro view to demonstrate it at the fixed exchange rate. This addresses Task R-069.

## Changes

- Library: add EUR formatting with a euro symbol, period thousands separators, and comma decimal separators.
- Corner Shop: add EUR selection, convert each USD unit price to EUR cents with nearest-integer rounding before multiplying quantities, and preserve the basket when switching currencies.
- Build: generate a EUR page and currency links between the USD, JPY, and EUR static views.
- Tests: cover EUR formatting, unit conversion, basket rounding, rendered prices and totals, server switching, and static navigation.

## How it was tested

Studio recorded passing CI, lint, and fail-first checks at `235859c5`. The six acceptance scenarios in `test/format.test.ts` and `test/shop.test.ts` fail on main and pass on this branch: EUR formatting, tea conversion to 782 cents, two plants totaling 3678 cents, euro rendering for `tea:1,mug:2`, server switching with `notebook:3` preserved, and static links between all three currencies. Server verification uses an isolated temporary server; static-build verification uses temporary output. The fresh reviewer approved the same head.

| Acceptance line | Test | Fails on main |
|---|---|---|
| In ``, the EUR cent-formatting scenario asserts that `format(123456, "EUR")` equals `€1.234,56`; planned fail-first: base returns `$1234.56` instead of the requested euro display. | test/format.test.ts | Yes (fail-first at 235859c5) |
| In ``, the EUR conversion scenario asserts that a tea unit priced at 850 USD cents becomes 782 EUR cents at 1 USD = 0.92 EUR; planned fail-first: base leaves the amount at 850. | test/shop.test.ts | Yes (fail-first at 235859c5) |
| In ``, the EUR basket scenario asserts that two plant units priced at 1999 USD cents each total 3678 EUR cents, following the existing nearest-integer conversion of each unit before multiplication; planned fail-first: base totals 3998. | test/shop.test.ts | Yes (fail-first at 235859c5) |
| In ``, the EUR rendering scenario asserts euro product prices, basket line amounts, and total for `tea:1,mug:2`, including tea at `€7,82`, the mug line at `€22,08`, and total at `€29,90`; planned fail-first: base renders dollar amounts. | test/shop.test.ts | Yes (fail-first at 235859c5) |
| In ``, the server currency-switch scenario follows the EUR option with `notebook:3` and observes the preserved basket, EUR selected state, euro currency description, and displayed demo rate 1 USD = 0.92 EUR; planned fail-first: base has no EUR option and an EUR request falls back to USD. | test/shop.test.ts | Yes (fail-first at 235859c5) |
| In ``, the static-build scenario observes a reachable euro page from the generated USD and JPY currency controls, with EUR selected and links back to both existing currencies; planned fail-first: base generates only USD and JPY pages. | test/shop.test.ts | Yes (fail-first at 235859c5) |

- [x] `bun test` passes
- [x] `bun run lint` passes

## Screenshots

Before and after captures are available in Studio under Task R-069. The dollar and yen shop views now include the `€ EUR` currency option. The designer approved both capture pairs at `235859c5`.

## Risk and rollback

EUR formatting, conversion rounding, or currency navigation could display incorrect amounts or links. The acceptance tests cover these paths in server and static views. Revert this pull request to remove EUR support; no persistent data migration is involved.

## Checklist

- [ ] Amounts stay integer cents end to end
- [ ] Existing currencies (USD, JPY) format exactly as before
- [ ] Docs and comments updated where behaviour changed
done: In `test/format.test.ts`, the EUR cent-formatting scenario asserts that `format(123456, "EUR")` equals `€1.234,56`; planned fail-first: base returns `$1234.56` instead of the requested euro display.
In `test/shop.test.ts`, the EUR conversion scenario asserts that a tea unit priced at 850 USD cents becomes 782 EUR cents at 1 USD = 0.92 EUR; planned fail-first: base leaves the amount at 850.

In `test/shop.test.ts`, the EUR basket scenario asserts that two plant units priced at 1999 USD cents each total 3678 EUR cents, following the existing nearest-integer conversion of each unit before multiplication; planned fail-first: base totals 3998.

In `test/shop.test.ts`, the EUR rendering scenario asserts euro product prices, basket line amounts, and total for `tea:1,mug:2`, including tea at `€7,82`, the mug line at `€22,08`, and total at `€29,90`; planned fail-first: base renders dollar amounts.

In `test/shop.test.ts`, the server currency-switch scenario follows the EUR option with `notebook:3` and observes the preserved basket, EUR selected state, euro currency description, and displayed demo rate 1 USD = 0.92 EUR; planned fail-first: base has no EUR option and an EUR request falls back to USD.

In `test/shop.test.ts`, the static-build scenario observes a reachable euro page from the generated USD and JPY currency controls, with EUR selected and links back to both existing currencies; planned fail-first: base generates only USD and JPY pages.
